McKinsey's State of AI (December 2025, https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai) shows no more than 10% of respondents report scaling AI agents in any individual function, indicating early-stage deployment. Deloitte's 2026 TMT Predictions (December 2025, https://www.deloitte.com/global/en/about/press-room/2026-tmt-predictions.html) forecasts the global agentic AI market could reach $45 billion by 2030, suggesting significant future growth. However, McKinsey's State of AI also notes that agentic AI scaling remains limited, with most organizations still in pilot or early implementation phases. The movement beyond chatbots is occurring but remains nascent.

overall_analysis: Evercore ISI's prediction on agentic AI and robotics moving beyond chatroom applications proved directionally accurate but premature in timing. While 2025 saw significant interest and investment in agentic AI as a major trend, actual deployment and scaling remained limited, with less than 10% of organizations reporting meaningful agent scaling. The prediction correctly identified the next frontier for AI but underestimated the time required for widespread implementation in production environments.
